name: Prism Launcher v12.0.0.11534 (Offline Mode & Direct Skin URL)
body:
### Prism Launcher (Offline Mode & Skin Visibility Enabled)

This release allows offline account creation, offline skins visibility (singleplayer, LAN, CustomSkinLoader, and SkinsRestorer servers), and gameplay without requiring Minecraft Microsoft account ownership.

#### Key Features:
- **Offline Account Skin Visibility (Self & LAN)**: Offline accounts now have full skin visibility in singleplayer and LAN worlds via dynamic runtime resource packs (classic, slim, and 1.19.3+ format support).
- **CustomSkinLoader Integration**: Automatically extracts and syncs offline player skins into `CustomSkinLoader/LocalSkin/skins/<player>.png` on launch.
- **Server Skin Sharing (`/skin` Command)**: Integrated server sharing controls in the Skin Manager dialog and Account list with 1-click copy and auto-copy on launch for SkinsRestorer / offline servers.
- **Cloud Skin Upload**: Built-in 1-click skin upload to Mineskin (generating official `textures.minecraft.net` URLs) with Catbox fallback.
- **Offline Mode Account Creation**: Directly create offline accounts via "Add Offline" without owning Minecraft on Microsoft.
- **Optional Microsoft Sign-In**: Microsoft account login remains available for users who own the game on Microsoft.
- **Custom Update Server & Auto Incremental Versioning**: Automatic updates pointing directly to this repository.

**Public Downloads:** Any user can download the installer or portable packages below without needing a GitHub account.
